document.abstract: This standard extends the Y′C′<inf>1</inf>C′<inf>2</inf>(A) image format defined in SMPTE ST 2073-3 to include subsampled color difference components (including 4:2:2, 4:2:0, 4:1:1, and 4:1:0). An alpha channel is optional and can have the same resolution as the Y? channel or the same resolution as the C′<inf>1</inf> and C′<inf>2</inf> channels. — This standard adds the AlphaSampling parameter to specify whether the alpha component is subsampled. — Operations that resample color difference components are out of scope.
